value.rationale: Negative attention already supports cycles, but the exact spectral-gap obstruction shows that no gain can stabilize a flip unless temperature resolves the second-strongest negative mode, while a different weakest eigenmode sets the sharp gain onset. This two-edge dependence (especially visible in dimension three) is a structural parameter classification for a natural normalized network, with a nontrivial exact rational Floquet benchmark and a strict open region of robust attraction; it is not merely a code or fixed-point check.
